project: LimbusLyric v1.8.9.133 RC11 through LYRIC IDENTITY FIREWALL H81

kugou.rule: Do not modify without explicit user approval and same-environment runtime evidence.
kugou.reason: The 22 currently source-locked KuGou golden methods remain protected. H11 changes are outer recovery/responsiveness closures and must not be used to replace KuGou transport authority.

qq_adapter.rule: Keep old baseline unless a reproducible QQ UIA parsing bug requires a targeted change.

legacy_unchanged_functions.rule: A failure is a review event. Never auto-regenerate the lock.

main_candidate.rule: Exact candidate tripwire. Update only after reviewing and approving an intentional diff.

behavior_requirements: Keep the 22 KuGou golden methods source-identical; Rail Local Master is the default public KuGou clock and read-only position scanners remain opt-in diagnostics.
Keep QQ hybrid: healthy GSMTC + UIA/local fallback; do not convert to GSMTC-only.
Keep QQ continuous-clock behavior aligned with the QQ_CONTINUOUS_CLOCK_20260815 software-2 baseline.
Do not add GSMTC-veto, cross-bind track-switch hold, or live-duration lyric rejection to QQ without same-machine evidence.
Keep NetEase native cloudmusic_detector default path.
Do not bundle/install BetterNCM; dormant opt-in bridge backend may remain.
Keep logs in the unified per-user %LOCALAPPDATA%\LimbusLyric\logs pool (application/TEMP only as runtime fallback); retain at most 5 session logs and keep logging off player/render timing paths.
Keep pywin32==311 and frozen dependency smoke test.
Keep PyInstaller onedir -> Inno Setup build route.
Keep H15 update execution gated by HTTPS installer + SHA-256; missing digest is manual-download only.
Keep the R4 frontend and H15 update plumbing presentation/control-only; they must not become player or lyric clock authority.
Keep H16 presentation runtime wiring outside player authority: font-size/weight, exit lifecycle, cover-follow and clear-subtitle UI must not change clock/seek/provider ownership.
forbidden_review_shortcuts: Do not delete code solely because static analysis says unused.
Do not mass-format or mass-refactor the 65k-line monolith.
Do not simplify provider-specific fallbacks into one generic clock.
Do not remove broad exception guards in bulk.
Do not regenerate hashes just to make a failing integrity gate green.
Do not change dependency versions casually.
Do not reintroduce BetterNCM installer/plugin payload.
qq_policy: QQ time authority remains locked to the user-provided QQ_CONTINUOUS_CLOCK_20260815 software-2 baseline; recovery/identity guards may quarantine unvalidated gesture samples or reject wrong lyric versions, never replace lyric-time authority.

qq_interaction_patch.policy: software-2 time authority exact; geometry/evidence may only trigger observation, stale-control reacquisition and delayed-seek recognition
async_reader_safe_changes: QQ soft track reset with epoch discard
reacquire epoch discards in-flight old-wrapper result
seek-time stale live-control reacquire on existing COM worker
rail-gesture candidate quarantine before generic merge

lyric_identity_guard.policy: For QQ auto search, current player duration is evidence for version identity; wrong same-title duration candidates fail closed.
lyric_identity_guard.auto_track_duration_source: post-bind QQ track epoch unless qq-track-switch-hint

kugou_causal_clock_guard.policy: motion-only numeric memory is discovery evidence, not public lyric-time authority
kugou_causal_clock_guard.paused_moving_candidate_action: session-ban + protected anchor reject + matching persisted seed removal

h12_policy.capture: WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE only on Windows build >=19041; no WDA_MONITOR fallback

h13_policy.scope: outer output / exact per-track lyric-content ownership / strict local-GSMTC Spotify
h13_policy.lyric_identity: exact normalized song+artist; no artist-less style fallback
h13_policy.obs: presentation-only mirror; no MediaSync; bounded current-visual-region capture at 20fps
h13_policy.spotify: Windows local GSMTC + bounded spotify.exe liveness only; no Web API/OAuth/window-title/UIA authority
h13_policy.runtime_order: H13 closures must execute before __main__ startup block

h16_policy.clear_subtitle_capacity: current + fully readable history; fading lane separate
